note: Evidence ledger of scientific corrections (sci-fix). correctness: C0 none, C1 pinned values or behavioral assertions only, C2 one independent oracle kind, C3 two or more independent oracle kinds plus an invariant and a negative control, C4 exhaustive or symbolic over a stated finite domain. discrimination: D0 no record that the evidence failed on the parent, D1 a combined count or before/after values only, D2 a per-test parent record, D3 D2 plus local mutants killed. The axes are reported separately and never combined. Requirements: S1 C3 and D2; S2 C2 and D2; S4 C1 and D2. A negative control that emulates the pre-fix behavior inside the test is evidence on the correctness axis, not a parent record.
